card.name: Inside the word heparin
card.fires_on: The middle pieces "par" or "epar" of the word heparin (He-par-in), in drug labels on anticoagulants and PCI. It also fires on the final "in" of heparin.

modes.label: Lowercase he-par
modes.description: The "par" piece after "he" in heparin, mid-sentence.
modes.example: administered in the same intravenous line as he<<par>>in, atropine sulfate, do

modes.label: Capitalized H-epar
modes.description: The "epar" piece after a capital H at the start of a sentence or bullet.
modes.example: H<<epar>>in use is discouraged after the PCI procedure
